MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish cage.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy.

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Physiology.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Physiology.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Physiology.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
